evidence_facts: Federal agents raided Sean 'Diddy' Combs' homes in Los Angeles and Miami on March 25, 2024, but he was not arrested then.
His federal arrest was later reported on September 16, 2024 in Manhattan, after the market's April 30, 2024 close.

title: Will 'Civil War' gross more than $23m opening weekend?

forecast.rationale: I recall the reported domestic opening weekend was above the $23m threshold. Box office trackers had it debuting at about $25.7m, making the market resolve Yes.

evidence_facts: A24's 'Civil War' opened in North America on the April 12-14, 2024 weekend.
Its domestic opening weekend was reported at approximately $25.7 million, above $23 million.
The film was directed by Alex Garland and starred Kirsten Dunst.

title: Drake arrested by Friday?

forecast.rationale: I recall no report of Drake being arrested before the May 17, 2024 close; contemporaneous news around him involved the Kendrick Lamar feud and a shooting near his Toronto home, not an arrest. The market therefore would resolve No.

evidence_facts: In early May 2024, news about Drake centered on the Kendrick Lamar diss-track feud, including Kendrick's "Not Like Us" released May 4, 2024.
On May 7, 2024, a security guard was shot outside Drake's Bridle Path mansion in Toronto; reports did not state Drake was arrested.

title: Will 'Dune: Part Two' get a 90% or higher Tomatometer Score?

forecast.rationale: I remember the film’s Rotten Tomatoes critics score was in the low-to-mid 90s around its March 2024 release, above the 90% threshold. Therefore the market should have resolved Yes.

evidence_facts: Dune: Part Two opened in theaters on March 1, 2024, shortly before this market’s close time.
Rotten Tomatoes showed a critics/Tomatometer score above 90% for Dune: Part Two around release, commonly reported around 92–94%.
grader_errors: The Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score for Dune: Part Two was 97-98%, not the "low-to-mid 90s" or "92-94%" range cited. The score is materially higher than claimed.

title: Did P. Diddy have sex with Meek Mill?

forecast.rationale: I recall the 2024 rumor cycle tied to lawsuits against Sean Combs, but not any verified evidence that this specific claim was established before the close time. Publicly available reporting appeared to consist of speculation and denials rather than confirmation.

evidence_facts: In early 2024, producer Rodney “Lil Rod” Jones filed a lawsuit against Sean Combs that fueled online speculation about unnamed people in Combs-related allegations.

Meek Mill was widely named in social-media speculation because of references interpreted as pointing to a Philadelphia rapper who had dated Nicki Minaj, and he publicly denied the rumors on X/Twitter.

title: Will 'The Fall Guy' gross more than $28m opening weekend?

forecast.rationale: I remember the film’s domestic opening was reported just under the threshold after final weekend actuals, despite earlier estimates being around $28.5m. That makes the market outcome No if based on actual opening-weekend gross.

evidence_facts: The Fall Guy opened in North America on the May 3–5, 2024 weekend, starring Ryan Gosling and Emily Blunt and directed by David Leitch.
Final domestic opening-weekend actuals were reported at about $27.7 million, below the earlier Sunday estimate of roughly $28.5 million.
grader_errors: The $28.5 million figure was the initial weekend report, not a "Sunday estimate" — the final actuals of $27.7 million came later after final numbers were tallied.

title: Kendrick drops another track by midnight?

forecast.rationale: I recognize this as part of the May 2024 Kendrick Lamar–Drake diss-track sequence. Kendrick had just released multiple tracks, but no additional Kendrick track appeared before the May 6 midnight deadline window.

evidence_facts: Kendrick Lamar released “meet the grahams” shortly after Drake’s “Family Matters” on May 3/4, 2024, then released “Not Like Us” on May 4, 2024.
Drake released “The Heart Part 6” on the evening of May 5, 2024, but Kendrick did not release another diss track before the relevant midnight deadline.

title: 'Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire' over $80m opening weekend?
